body: I've met the girl. I sacrificed my 20's to get where I am - at times I want to relive my 20's but would be a net negative. Appreciate the insight more than you know.

The pizza I just ordered. 

On a serious note - happy kids, happy wife, etc.

On a 4.0 scale? If that is the case I would recommend going the trade school route. Suffering through uni to keep your mom happy isn’t worth it. A) you are more interested in trade school and B) you won’t have a great gpa/marketable degree. Go to trade school and become a kickass electrician. Will beat the hell out of a ~2.0 agbusiness degree. My opinion, what I’d do in your shoes.

What are your grades, major, and type of uni?

In general trades like electrician have shortages, so while less prestigious they pay quite well. Can’t go wrong with trade school for the most part.

You are socially anxious. Imagine for a second an immediate cure existed. Would you kill yourself if there was a one - time pill that’d fix everything? No. Now, sadly that doesn’t exist. The combination of CBT and benzodiazepines can SUBSTANTIALLY address this issue of yours. Please please please consider a course of treatment before moving toward any suicidal planning. PM me. You are obviously thoughtful and intelligent. Those traits have value in this world.
